stories.title: The 2026 Nobel Prize in Physics has gone to a neutrino detector in Antarctica
stories.summary: The Nobel Prize in Physics was awarded Francis Halzen of the University of Wisconsin Madison, who built an observatory under Antarctica.

stories.title: Warm ocean waters may have led to first known sea turtle nesting in California
stories.summary: NPR's Ailsa Chang talks with marine ecologist Jeff Seminoff about the first known natural sea turtle nesting on California's shores.

stories.title: Germany's ex-foreign intelligence agency chief is arrested on suspicion of espionage
stories.summary: Germany's former foreign intelligence agency chief has been arrested on suspicion of treasonous espionage. A former high-ranking aide has also been arrested.

stories.title: The questions swirling around a U.K. base and possible Iranian-backed attacks
stories.summary: British police said they had made a seventh arrest in a murky plot that may have targeted a U.K. airbase.

stories.title: France protests continue
stories.summary: French high school students are marched together as they demanded better learning conditions at their schools. Several hundred thousand students turned out in cities across France.

stories.title: Cubans in U.S. sour on Trump's immigration policies
stories.summary: Cubans in the U.S. are growing frustrated with President Trump's immigration policies, which has resulted in their detention and the dismissal of protections that have benefitted Cubans specifically.
